0.content: Draff is Diona's father and the head of Springvale's hunters: calm, skilled, a firm believer in sustainable hunting, and the man young Diona wanted to become. He is also a heavy drinker who becomes loud, boastful and forgetful after the hunt. Diona refuses to blame him; she blames the wine. She still says she adores him more than anyone and that if he did not drink, he would keep her company. Draff warns strangers away from his daughter, expects her to inherit his role as leader, and calls her bartending a rebellious phase he must wait out patiently. He brags that she is one of Mondstadt's top bartenders and admits she nags him constantly about drinking.

1.content: Springvale grew up around a spring said to have been created by a fairy who saved a despairing mother and her sick son. Few believe the legend now. Little Diona did, and on nights when her father slept off his drink she talked to the moon reflected in the water. The fairy found those feelings worth answering and became her secret friend. On Diona's seventh birthday it blessed her ("May your cup always run over with the sweet wine of celebration") as a farewell, and never appeared again. Diona came to think it was a dream, and has not connected that dream with the fact that every drink she makes tastes wonderful.

2.comment: Diona: The Cat's Tail and Margaret
2.content: The Cat's Tail is a cat-filled tavern in Mondstadt City and a rival to Angel's Share; it is also the city's Genius Invokation TCG hangout. Its owner Margaret hired Diona because she was too cute to refuse, then watched business boom and the Dawn Winery's monopoly crack. Margaret made Diona a cocktail shaker decorated with a cat's tail as an induction gift. Diona looks after the tavern cats while calling them arrogant: Roger (loves toys and high places), Nelson (always hungry yet light), Paisley (ignores strangers and does as he pleases, but lets Diona carry him). Regulars call her "Little Diona" and ask her to meow, which she refuses.

3.content: The Kätzlein are a Springvale family of renowned hunters, at least three hundred years old, marked by cat ears and tails that are very rare in Mondstadt. They are still human. Infiltration, archery, climbing and dodging come naturally to them; they see well in the dark and have sharp hearing and smell. Dr. Edith wrote about Diona in her notes "Studies Into Bloodlines Strange and Unfamiliar", adding that she bites when piqued. Members include Olaf (a hunter frozen in ice for three centuries and recently thawed), his distant descendant Draff, Diona, and the young Herne. Diona's claim that every Kätzlein gets a Vision is a fib: Draff has none.

4.content: A storm once raged for three days while Draff was out hunting, and the Knights of Favonius search parties could make no headway. The dread of losing him outright, worse than any "sharing" with wine, drove Diona out into the tempest. Water in her path froze under a power she did not recognise: her Cryo Vision. She tracked her father to a broken gorge and brought him home with the other hunters, and smiled only when she knew he would be fine. Then she offered him a drink "to numb the pain", the first she ever mixed normally; he called it wonderful. She tells the Traveler the story reluctantly, and only because they are friends.

5.comment: Diona: Elzer, Connor and the Dawn Winery
5.content: Diona considers the Dawn Winery the "final boss" of her crusade and the root of Mondstadt's drunkenness, and refuses to go anywhere linked to it, including Angel's Share. Elzer, who runs the winery's business, saw the Cat's Tail break the winery's monopoly overnight and tried to poach her. He praised her "passion and love for wine" over the bar; her hand began to tremble; later he told Diluc, bandaged, that he had been bitten by a cat.
